description: This file defines an abstract base class 'ConfigBase' for configuration objects in Drupal, providing get/set support, validation, merging, and cache handling.

classes.name: ConfigBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing core functionality for configuration objects, including name management, data handling, validation, and cache integration.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the configuration object.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the configuration object.

methods.name: validateName
methods.description: Validates the configuration object name for namespace, length, and invalid characters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves data from the configuration object, supporting nested keys with dot notation.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Replaces the entire data array of the configuration object after validation.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a specific value in the configuration data, supporting nested keys.

methods.name: validateKeys
methods.description: Recursively validates keys in a configuration array to ensure no dots are present.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes a key or nested key from the configuration data.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges an array of data into the configuration data.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts for the configuration object.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags, including the configuration name.

methods.name: castSafeStrings
methods.description: Converts objects implementing MarkupInterface to strings within data.
